$comment: dsh-forge pipeline manifest — the declarative control flow the dsh-pipeline-executor runs. This file IS the pipeline: stages, role confinement, gates, retries. The conductor model never sees or transmits it; the executor reads it from disk. File-reference paths (roles/, schemas/, prompts/) are preset-dir-relative. Gate argv elements are template-rendered by the executor (0.1.3) before execFile: gates run with cwd = workspace, so validator paths are spelled {{PRESET_DIR}}-absolute and workspace paths {{WORKSPACE}}-absolute. L0 draft — L1 implements the executor against exactly this shape; fields may only be added, never reinterpreted.

stages.$comment: zipper runs on v4-flash (wall-clock directive 2026-08-18): mechanical compression at 1/3 price and higher speed; the compression gate catches quality failures, and a flash-red retries per the charter table. First live measurement = E5. targets [skill] (0.1.5, wall-clock directive 2026-08-18): zipper runs only for skill builds — plugin/preset artifacts are code+config with no prose to compress; any other target value skips the stage (ledgered, gateExit=0, conductor proceeds).

fanout.$comment: Battery scale is budgeted to ~engineer level (user directive 2026-08-18): THREE default lenses (coherence/gaming/reality — the concrete-defect catchers); evidence and foundation are opt-in for high-stakes runs by listing them here. Lens output capped at 12288; synthesis keeps 24576 (it emits the full decision record — starving it reproduces the guidance-class death). Seeds and PROVE-OR-FLAG discipline unchanged.

gate.$comment: L4 chain: the fold gate first, then the MECHANICAL evidence assembler — `then` runs only on validate_decision exit 0 (an acceptance manifest is never assembled from an invalid decision record), and its exit IS the gate verdict (a refused assembly is a red battery gate: evidence ships or the stage fails). --provider mirrors defaults.provider (the ledger pins roleModel but not provider).
